paragraphs: Rav Chiyya bar Ammi, the priest. I do not know the basis for saying he was the son of Ammi the priest. Ammi the priest is everywhere called R. Ammi, while R. Chiyya bar Ammi is nowhere mentioned as “son of Rabbi Ammi.” Many are called bar Ammi; see there. In Ulla's name: Berakhot 8a. Abaye said, “Once I heard what R. Chiyya bar Ammi said in Ulla's name.” See also Shabbat 17b; also there, 79a. In that matter in Gittin, chapter 2, 22a, “Rav Chiyya bar Assi in Ulla's name” is a scribal error and should read “bar Ammi”; the new Talmud editions did not correct it. Chagigah 25; Chullin 163a [as cited]; Avodah Zarah 37a. In Ulpana's name—see there—Arakhin 28b; and Rav Yosef—Shabbat 106a. R. Ammi bar Chiyya—perhaps his son.
